warnings: Extensive use of pickle.load() on .pkl files poses a security risk; pickle deserialization can execute arbitrary code if file integrity is compromised or if generated by untrusted upstream processes.
sys.path.append() modifies the global module search path at runtime, which can lead to import shadowing and conflicts in larger robot software stacks.
